arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ.
transliteration: Allahumma innee as'aluka khayrahaa wa khayra maa jabaltahaa 'alayh, wa a'oothu bika min sharrihaa wa sharri maa jabaltahaa 'alayh.
translation: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that You have made her inclined towards, and I seek refuge in You from the evil within her and the evil that You have made her inclined towards. (If it is a camel, he should take hold of the top of its hump and say the same)
